name: Eferhild Citadel
description: Once known as the Cauldron of Moritar, the place was a fortress of the Mystical Kingdom, full of arcane protections that remain until today. The place is near a lava river, favoring metal weapons and armor creation. Katar and Mother Grizza reside there, harnessing the site’s potent magic to enhance all shamanic abilities. Influenced by the shamanic tradition, each resident has a totem in their home and meditates to contact their guardian animal spirit. Katar tries to improve the lives of the people; despite not being wealthy, food and water are distributed, and people are asked to work properly to ensure the services and basic needs of everyone. One particular shaman named Martuk claims that he can use spirits of magical beasts for his protection, and they are much more potent but demand some special actions to bound, often involving either the killing of individuals or causing significant destruction. Secretly, he is gathering more followers every day. This city also has an immense dungeon full of lava and protection from the wizards of the past. Some orcs have attempted to explore it, but none have successfully navigated its depths. Mother Grizza believes something important is hidden there, but she and Katar cannot afford to be absent for days exploring the site.
